name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at the Universidad de Chile, he became fascinated by the application of aerodynamics to racing. He started volunteering at a local racing team, quickly proving his aptitude for understanding airflow and downforce. His dedication and innovative thinking led to a full-time position, where he honed his skills in wind tunnel testing and computational fluid dynamics. 

Ricardo is now the Head of Aero at Academy Motorsport. He believes in a data-driven approach, combined with intuitive understanding. He's known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to translate complex scientific principles into practical, race-winning solutions. Ricardo is particularly proud of his work on developing adaptive aerodynamic systems, always striving for the perfect balance of speed and stability.

physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build, with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches.
Insists on using a specific type of Chilean coffee bean for his morning brew.
Often mutters aerodynamic equations under his breath when observing the cars.
